cadence: per query; a client that asked for a name and record type in the last five minutes answers from its own cache and is not logged again
notes: One folder per organisation: city, nascc, brw, port, srmc, bcmc, county. Each organisation has its own products, rule names, zone names and habits; do not assume a value seen in one folder means the same in another. Hosts, addresses and accounts are in 06_data_streams/partner_it_registry.json.

fields.name: answer
fields.notes: the address returned (the one the client then connects to); a name for SRV queries; - when there is none

fields.name: resolver
fields.notes: address of the resolver that answered (registry host)
